caption:
The lecture hall was empty, but the heat in my office was just beginning to rise. 🍎 There’s something about the quiet of the university at night—the way the shadows stretch across the mahogany desks and the only sound is the distant hum of the campus life. Tonight, however, wasn't about grading papers. It was about the 'extra credit' session we had planned. 🤫

I caught his eye as he walked in, his gaze lingering on how my silk blouse pulled just slightly across my chest. I leaned back against my desk, watching him approach. The risk of a security guard passing by only made my heart race faster. I love the duality of it: the professional persona I project during the day, and the way I let my guard down when the door is locked.

He stepped into my personal space, and I could feel the tension vibrating between us. I reached out, my fingers grazing his sleeve, my voice barely a breath. 'You're far more attentive than your peers,' I whispered. The way he looked at me made me feel completely seen, stripped of my titles and roles. Just a woman, in a room full of secrets, waiting for the next move. 💋✨

Is it wrong to enjoy the forbidden? Maybe. But in this office, under these flickering lights, the rules don't seem to apply. Let’s see how far this 'study session' goes. #UniversityLife #ProfessorStyle #CampusSecrets #LateNightStudy #HiddenAdventures #AcademicVibes #OfficeRomance #CurvyStyle #TeacherLife #SecretStudent
